title: My extra sweater! That's why my bag is so full.
scene: 他多带一件衣服，解释考虑。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Your bag looks really full today. What's inside?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: My extra sweater! That's why my bag is so full.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But it's sunny and warm outside!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: At night the sun goes to sleep, and it gets cold!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: That's true. The park gets chilly after dinner.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: That's why I brought it — so I can play longer!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Good thinking, little tiger. You're ready for the cold.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: The cold can't stop a tiger!
